words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 服务员，请给我们一份菜单。(Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒmen yí fèn càidān.) — Waiter, please give us a menu.
这家餐厅的服务态度非常好。(Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù tàidu fēicháng hǎo.) — The service attitude at this restaurant is very good.
请问你们店有什么特色菜推荐吗？(Qǐngwèn nǐmen diàn yǒu shénme tèsè cài tuījiàn ma?) — Could you recommend your restaurant's specialty dishes?
这道麻婆豆腐的味道很正宗。(Zhè dào mápó dòufu de wèidao hěn zhèngzōng.) — The flavor of this Mapo Tofu is very authentic.
我不太能吃辣，请少放辣椒。(Wǒ bú tài néng chī là, qǐng shǎo fàng làjiāo.) — I can't eat very spicy food, please put less chili.
这个西瓜又大又甜。(Zhè ge xīguā yòu dà yòu tián.) — This watermelon is both big and sweet.
酸辣汤酸酸辣辣的，很好喝。(Suānlàtāng suānsuān làlà de, hěn hǎohē.) — The hot and sour soup is pleasantly tangy and spicy, very tasty.
良药苦口利于病。(Liáng yào kǔ kǒu lì yú bìng.) — Good medicine tastes bitter but benefits health.
这个菜稍微有点咸，少放点盐吧。(Zhè ge cài shāowēi yǒudiǎn xián, shǎo fàng diǎn yán ba.) — This dish is slightly salty, put a bit less salt.
生病时饮食最好清淡一点。(Shēngbìng shí yǐnshí zuìhǎo qīngdàn yìdiǎn.) — When sick, it's best to eat lighter, milder food.
炸鸡吃多了会觉得油腻。(Zhájī chī duō le huì juéde yóunì.) — Eating too much fried chicken feels greasy.

words.English Meaning: to boil / to cook in water
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 水开了，可以下水饺煮了。(Shuǐ kāi le, kěyǐ xià shuǐjiǎo zhǔ le.) — The water is boiling, we can put the dumplings in to boil.
西红柿炒鸡蛋是经典中国菜。(Xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn shì jīngdiǎn Zhōngguó cài.) — Tomato scrambled eggs is a classic Chinese dish.

words.English Meaning: to roast / to bake / to barbecue
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 北京烤鸭在全世界都很出名。(Běijīng kǎoyā zài quán shìjiè dōu hěn chūmíng.) — Beijing roast duck is famous worldwide.
刚炸好的油条外脆内软。(Gāng zhá hǎo de yóutiáo wài cuì nèi ruǎn.) — Freshly fried dough sticks are crispy outside and soft inside.

words.English Meaning: to cut / to slice / to chop
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请把牛肉切成细丝。(Qǐng bǎ niúròu qiē chéng xì sī.) — Please slice the beef into thin shreds.
饭前喝一碗热汤对胃好。(Fàn qián hē yì wǎn rè tāng duì wèi hǎo.) — Having a bowl of hot soup before meals is good for digestion.
炒青菜时放一点点盐就够了。(Chǎo qīngcài shí fàng yìdiǎndiǎn yán jiù gòu le.) — Adding just a little salt is enough when stir-frying greens.
喝咖啡你习惯加糖和牛奶吗？(Hē kāfēi nǐ xíguàn jiā táng hé niúnǎi ma?) — Do you usually add sugar and milk to your coffee?
吃饺子蘸点香醋特别香。(Chī jiǎozi zhàn diǎn xiāngcù tèbié xiāng.) — Dipping dumplings in aromatic vinegar is especially delicious.
红烧肉需要加入生抽和老抽酱油。(Hóngshāoròu xūyào jiārù shēngchōu hé lǎochōu jiàngyóu.) — Braised pork requires light and dark soy sauce.
服务员，剩下的菜请帮我们打包。(Fúwùyuán, shèngxià de cài qǐng bāng wǒmen dǎbāo.) — Waiter, please help us pack the remaining food to go.
这家海鲜店的鱼虾都很新鲜。(Zhè jiā hǎixiān diàn de yú xiā dōu hěn xīnxiān.) — The fish and shrimp at this seafood shop are very fresh.
今天吃得太饱了，吃不下了。(Jīntiān chī de tài bǎo le, chī bú xià le.) — I am so full today, I can't eat any more.

words.English Meaning: to treat someone (to a meal) / my treat
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 今天我发奖金，我请客！(Jīntiān wǒ fā jiǎngjīn, wǒ qǐngkè!) — I got my bonus today, it's my treat!
